msg: [package] has no description - crates.io refuses the upload. Add description = "one sentence".
[package] has neither license nor license-file - crates.io refuses the upload. Add license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0".
Wildcard version "*" - crates.io rejects wildcard dependency constraints. Pin a caret range such as "1".
git = dependency - crates.io rejects git dependencies. Publish that crate first and depend on its registry version.
path = dependency with no version - cargo publish stops: all path dependencies must also carry a version.
More than 5 keywords - crates.io accepts at most 5.
Keyword longer than 20 characters - crates.io rejects it.
More than 5 categories - crates.io accepts at most 5.
publish = false - cargo publish refuses to upload this crate. Remove the key when the crate is meant to go out.
[package] has no repository - the crates.io page ships with no source link and the version is frozen that way.
[package] has no readme - the crates.io page body stays empty for this version forever.
edition is absent or 2015 - cargo falls back to the 2015 edition for this published version.
version = 0.0.0 - a placeholder version number gets burned on crates.io and can never be re-uploaded.
